gpu_core_count.name: GPU core count
gpu_core_count.description: Here, you can manually specify your GPU core count. If set at 0, Bismuth attempts to find the core count manually. If it can't find it, make sure you set this value correctly. You can also try different values to see how it affects performance.

ingame_enable.name: Enable debug tools
ingame_enable.description:
Allows you to enable and disable Bismuth while playing by pressing F8. It also allows you to use Difference Mode by pressing F9 (Difference Mode is very unstable).

 WARNING: This option effectively removes any optimization.

use_mapped_buffers.name: Use persistently mapped buffers
use_mapped_buffers.description: May work well with integrated GPU, not so much with discrete GPUs (like a graphics card)
